_source: axibridge test-fixtures/boon/20260117-181030.json (dps.report EI JSON, accounts anonymized)
_note: Golden aggregates for axilog WvW parity. Task 3 (M2): squadAppliedCrowdControl(Duration)/squadStunBreak/squadRemovedStunDuration are sums of statsAll[0].appliedCrowdControl(Duration) / support[0].stunBreak(removedStunDuration) over all 41 players; per-player appliedCrowdControl/appliedCrowdControlDuration/stunBreak/removedStunDuration below are the same source fields joined by account. Task 5 (M2): player[].account values were regenerated to `Anon<N>.<4 digits>` (N = raw agent-table index, same deterministic formula as `axilog_core::evtc::anon_account`) so they equal what `fixtures/wvw-small.anon.zevtc` (committed, PII-safe) decodes to at that same index — the real .zevtc stays local-only, gitignored, PII, never committed. The old->new mapping for this one-time regeneration was derived by joining each real account's sha256-based EI-obfuscated form (still present as `ei_account_obfuscation` in `crates/axilog-cli/tests/cli.rs`, kept as a historical/standalone-tested reference) to its raw agent-table index. The `professions_match_ei_golden` test itself now joins purely by raw agent-table index (via `anon_account(i)`), which works identically against the committed anon fixture or the real local one. 4 rows keep their original `Non Squad Player N` placeholder account (EI's own label for non-squad players present in the encounter but outside the recorded squad) since they never had a real account to map from. Task 2 (M3): each player's `boons` object holds the 12 tracked-boon skill ids (see `axilog_core::analysis::buffs::BOON_IDS`) -> EI's raw `buffUptimes[].buffData[0]` `{uptime, presence}` pair, verbatim (0/0 when the id is absent from the source `buffUptimes` array, i.e. the player never held that buff at all). EI's own field meaning differs by boon stack type (verified directly from these numbers, e.g. player Anon132.5884's Might=740 uptime=7.808/presence=88.962 vs Fury=725 uptime=68.459/presence=0): for DURATION-type boons (everything except Might=740/Stability=1122) `uptime` IS the presence percentage (0-100) and `presence` is always 0/unused; for INTENSITY-type boons (Might, Stability) `uptime` is the time-weighted average stack count and `presence` is the presence percentage (0-100). This asymmetry is exactly what the M3 Task 2 brief flagged and what `boons_golden.rs` decodes per-boon via `BOON_IDS`'s `is_intensity` flag. Same real-account join method as Task 5's account regeneration (obfuscate(real account) -> raw agent-table index -> `Anon<N>`), cross-checked against 3 independent fields (profession, `dpsAll[0].damage`, `statsAll[0].appliedCrowdControl`) for all 41 players with zero mismatches before trusting the join for `boons`. Task 3 (M3): each player's `support` object holds EI's raw `support[0]` `{condiCleanse, condiCleanseSelf, boonStrips, resurrects}` fields (durations/downContribution fields omitted, not needed by this task), extracted the same way as `boons` (same index-order join, cross-checked). `squadCondiCleanse`/`squadCondiCleanseSelf`/`squadBoonStrips`/`squadResurrects` are sums of the same fields over all 41 players (801/97/437/6) -- the calibration targets `support_golden.rs` checks against. Task 4 (M3): each squad-member player's `generation` object holds the 12 tracked-boon skill ids -> `{self, group, squad}`, EI's own precomputed per-source generation rollups verbatim (`selfBuffs`/`groupBuffs`/`squadBuffs`[boon].buffData[0].generation from the source EI JSON -- see `GW2EIEvtcParser/EIData/Actors/Player.cs`'s `ComputeBuffs`: `self` = `GetBuffsForSelf` (how much of THIS player's own boon-time they generated for themselves), `group` = `GetBuffsForPlayers(PlayerList.Where(p.Group==Group && p!=this))` (averaged, over this player's own subgroup excluding self, of how much boon-time this player generated for each teammate), `squad` = `GetBuffsForPlayers(PlayerList.Where(p!=this))` (same average but over the whole squad excluding self) -- all on the SAME 0-100 (duration boons) / raw-average-stack-count (Might, Stability -- no *100) scale as `boons.uptime` above, verified against `BuffStatistics.cs`. Same real-account join method as Tasks 2/3 M3 (obfuscate(real account) -> raw agent-table index -> `Anon<N>`), cross-checked the same 3 fields with zero mismatches. 37 of 41 players have a `generation` object: the 4 `Non Squad Player N` rows are excluded (out of scope -- self/group/squad rollups only apply to real recorded squad members, i.e. `Player.subgroup != 0`, per the Task 3 finding these 4 rows are excluded from EI's own `log.PlayerList` too). A 42nd real squad member the decoded local fixture reports (`rincka.1608`, would be `Anon142.6254`) has never been one of this fixture's 41 `players` rows at all, in ANY field, since Task 2 (M3) first generated it -- the source axibridge JSON export for this log has no matching player entry for them (not a gap introduced by this task).
